name: Bone meal
note: Dispensers' bone meal on crops, stems, cocoa, berry bushes, bamboo, dripleaves, petals and vines, used up only when it acts, as both official servers do draw for draw; players' bone meal acts the same way
deviations: players' bone meal is not compared
saplings, grass, moss, mushrooms and nylium (their features), glow lichen, sea pickles, seagrass, coral and propagules take none
